facts.t: 277 vehicles to discover for the full completion row
255 animals to log in the hunting journal
80 challenges exist; the trophy takes 50, completion takes all 80
300 stunt jumps; the trophy takes 250, completion takes all 300
18 meditation spots, tracked by the in-game counter
52 named areas to explore across Leonida
42 shooting range challenges, all gold for The Shootist
9 gangs run illegal operations; 9 activity types for the sampler
500 tracked choices feed Actions Speak Louder

note: The 7-stage roadmap to the platinum. Every action and fact cites the numbered registry in sources.json; stage hours and PSN points are computed by the app from trophies.json, not stored here.

actions.t: Play Gone Fishing and learn the phone, casting and the interaction wheel
Bank a Chapter 1 manual save before the chapter finale
Meditate at the Vice Beach balcony spot NOW — the possibly missable one
Take the Ocean Beach cocktail moment while the bar is in its early story state
Bowl one game at Kolt & Associates (also ticks an activity type)
Finish one arcade game at the Vice Beach arcade
Fail one gentle checkpoint and pass the retry (Bad Luck, I Guess)
Complete The Cartel Heist and learn the vault-and-escape loop
Complete Child's Play; spend Combat Focus early in the ambush
Take the unscheduled departure while the story has you inside VCIA
Drop 5 enemies in one Combat Focus at a gang spot (Gunslinger)
Land a melee drive-by knockdown on a Vice Beach sidewalk (Ten Pin)
Start the vehicle-discovery habit: drive everything new you pass
Make a fresh manual save at the chapter's end
Complete Headliners and VCIA Takedown as they unlock
Beat Cal in his fishing challenge before he leaves the coast arc
Take the scripted jewelry-store stealth window (Sneakthief)
Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner grouped (Hot Together)
Start the Top Fun drone circuit on the Vice Beach courses
Favourite the WAiNK app and start shooting spots opportunistically
Meet the first strangers and start their strand clocks running
Bank your second insurance save at the chapter start
Complete Operation Savage Glory; engage the Rhinos, do not avoid them
Chain 3 shop robberies back-to-back with your partner (Retail Therapy)
Smash out of the showroom in the story visit (Capital Offense)
Keep your partner grouped through the boardwalk set-piece (Personal Best)
Push every open stranger strand one stage further
Continue the meditation sweep across the newly opened coast
Sweep the watch list: anything still open gets done or save-parked
Finish or deliberately schedule every named stranger strand
Stock ammo, armour and snacks for both partners
Play the final mission; checkpoints are generous, push through
In post-game, reconcile the in-game 100% checklist with our 100% view
Re-check the Missables view: closed items are what your pre-finale save is for
Settle into the free-roam grind order: stage 6 breadth, then stage 7 depth
Finish the five named strands, then any 3 short strands (8 total)
Win 20 different races and all 14 Top Fun drone locations
Rob 5 bank vaults with escapes, plus one armored truck
Rob one illegal operation per gang — all 9 gangs
Buy all 8 garages; launder $250,000 and spend $100,000 on the way
Uncover all 52 areas by boat, air and road
Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app as you discover them
Grind stunts to 250 for the silver, then all 300 for completion
Gold all 42 shooting range challenges, lane family by lane family
Close the meditation sweep and complete 3 card sets (then the full sweep)
Reach 100 WAiNK locations and 80 challenges
Top up tracked choices to 500 with post-game random encounters
Close the 100% checklist row by row — vehicles 277, animals 255 last
Watch the platinum pop when the 54th trophy lands
